22,Event,E-Pitch Cafe 2026,14th March 2026,9:00 AM - 6:00 PM IST,Delhi,In-Person Conference,Past,No,"E-Pitch Café 2026 Focused acceleration of ESDM startups through strategic pitching, funding support, and mentorship-driven product development.","E-Pitch Café 2026, held on 14 March 2026 as part of the E-Summit at Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi, was a flagship startup pitch and funding event focused on accelerating Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) innovations. The initiative brought together around 300 applicants, including student innovators, entrepreneurs, and startup teams, with 37 shortlisted teams pitching their ideas to expert panels.Structured across two tracks—Protostar (idea to POC) and Superstar (POC to prototype)—the event aimed to support startups at different stages of product development. A total funding pool of ₹30 lakhs was allocated, with 17 high-potential teams receiving grants to further develop their solutions.Evaluated by 25+ industry and academic experts across five specialised panels, startups were assessed on technical feasibility, market relevance, and execution clarity. Beyond funding, selected teams gained access to mentorship, incubation, infrastructure, and industry partnerships through the Centre for Intelligent Product Development (CiPD).The event was executed by CiPD  and student representatives from IIITD.",Startup Pitching
